items.title: What Is The True Hidden Price Of Marvell Stock?
items.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) stock, at $263.27 a share (September 29, 2026 close) and a market value of about $231 billion, trades at 80 times its past twelve months of adjusted earnings per share. That is steep for one year of profit, but Marvell's sales are growing fast, so the next two years matter more. What, then, is the real price of Marvell stock once you count the profit expected in those years.

items.title: Prediction: Rambus Could Be a Quiet Winner From Exploding AI Demand
items.summary: Rambus sits far below its 52-week high while AI server builders keep adding racks that depend on its chips. Whether the stock is a overlooked opportunity or a value trap comes down to a few critical revenue milestones in the quarters ahead.

items.title: When AMD's CEO and the Chart Say the Same Thing, Pay Attention
items.summary: On August 4, 2026, Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) guided third-quarter revenue to about $13 billion, above its $11.2 billion second-quarter guide. AMD stock has gained 25.4% since the August 3 close, the day before that release, against 0.9% for the S&P 500. Many rallies have no new company numbers behind them, so one backed by a higher forecast is worth a look. Below we look at AMD's new guidance, its share price trend, and what could lift the stock further.

items.title: Why Marvell Technology (MRVL) Stock Is Trading Up Today
items.summary: Shares of networking chips designer Marvell Technology (NASDAQ: MRVL) jumped 4.7% in the afternoon session after Citi reiterated a Buy rating and a $275 price target on the company ahead of its October 6 Investor Day.
